prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Create Your Custom Pet", "Upload a clear photo to generate your unique desktop companion.", "Ensure good lighting and a clear subject for best results.", "Choose Photo", "Live Preview"]
1: ["Your Pet is Ready!", "Click below to send your pet right to your desktop.", "Launch Pet"]
2: ["Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pet", "Keep your pet saved securely across restarts and device changes.", "Signing in ensures your pet stays tied to your account."]
3: ["Hatching Your Companion...", "We are preparing your pet's desktop personality.", "Tip: You can drag your pet anywhere on your desktop once loaded."]
4: ["Pick Your Companion Journey", "Select a quick preset companion or build a completely custom pet."]
5: ["Best results come from bright, single-subject photos facing forward.", "Recommended: JPG/PNG under 10MB"]
6: ["Desktop Readiness Check", "Confirm setup options before introducing your pet to your screen.", "Desktop overlay permission granted"]
7: ["Quick Account Access"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Friend", "Follow along to select how you want to create your pet.", "I'm ready when you are! Pick a path below."]
9: ["Generating Your Pet...", "Play chime when finished"]
